name: cowrite
description: Assist-only academic co-writing following DFG good scientific practice: hints instead of ghostwriting, a complete AI log, generated AI disclosure, and a pixel-art review party you compose yourself.

obsidianVault.title: Obsidian vault
obsidianVault.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault (optional). Claude reads it as your knowledge base.

aiNotesFolder.title: AI notes folder
aiNotesFolder.description: Folder inside the vault where AI-generated notes go, clearly marked.

language.title: Default language
language.description: Default language for new papers and disclosures.

autosave.title: Autosave to git
autosave.description: Commit the manuscript and the AI log after each change (once you pause for 30 s), under your own git name, so the history shows how your text grew next to the AI input. Only manuscript/ and ai-log/ are committed.

game.title: Gamification
game.description: Show XP, levels and achievements for your own writing.

zoteroLocalApi.title: Zotero local API
zoteroLocalApi.description: Search your running Zotero 7 (enable 'Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero' in Zotero settings).

watchModel.title: Live review model
watchModel.description: Model for /cowrite:watch live hints while you write (a small, fast one keeps it cheap), e.g. haiku.

focusMode.title: Focus mode
focusMode.description: How much of Claude Code's own work the transcript shows: off (all), calm (one dim line per action), focus (only you and the personas). /cowrite:quiet switches it per session.

usageMeter.title: Usage meter
usageMeter.description: Token counter in the pane and status line; with limits it also watches the 5-hour and weekly limits of a Pro/Max plan and warns at 80 % and 95 %.
